event.title: Rescue Efforts Underway in China After Landslide Traps Residents
event.canonical_title: Rescue Efforts Underway in China After Landslide Traps Residents
event.summary: A large-scale rescue operation is underway in Pengshui County, Chongqing municipality, following a landslide on July 17 that buried part of a residential area. Authorities are working to locate and rescue an unknown number of people trapped under the debris.

key_facts: Landslide occurred on July 17 in Pengshui County, Chongqing.
Part of a residential area was buried.
Rescue operations are ongoing to find trapped individuals.

revisions.title: Rescue Efforts Underway in China Following Landslide in Chongqing
revisions.summary: A significant landslide occurred in Pengshui County, Chongqing municipality, on July 17, burying part of a residential area. Chinese authorities have initiated a large-scale rescue operation to locate and assist those trapped beneath the debris, although the exact number of individuals affected remains unknown.
key_facts: Landslide struck Pengshui County in Chongqing on July 17.
Part of a residential area was buried.
Rescue operations are ongoing to find trapped individuals.
